name: Lack of Surplus
summary: Along the coast, Tok'Kar and his soldiers watch for murlocs threatening Stonard. When the force grows too large, they send warning; for now, Tok'Kar asks you to bring six sawtooth snapper claws.

sections.title: Weapons for the Coast
sections.body: Tok'Kar and the soldiers guard Stonard from murlocs along the coast. When the force is too large to face, they warn the town. Tok'Kar has little time to rest, so he asks you to help. Properly prepared, sawtooth snapper claws make fine weapons. Bring him six, and he offers one of the outpost's weapons in return, grateful for the meat and company.

faq.answer: Tok'Kar, stationed along the coast to protect Stonard, asks you for the claws.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar need sawtooth snapper claws?
faq.answer: Properly prepared sawtooth snapper claws make fine weapons, and Tok'Kar wants six.

faq.q: What threat is the coastal post watching for?
faq.answer: The soldiers watch for murlocs along the coast. They protect Stonard or warn the town if the force is too large.
